question: Can a redesigned co-occurring drift+noise measurement — using drift patterns that do NOT uniformly block all endpoints (permission_boundary, session_invalidation) and an independent unauthenticated structural probe (/schema endpoint) — demonstrate that behavioral and structural signals are independently observable on the same conditions, and does the Pearson correlation between paired behavioral and structural sample scores fall below 0.3?
hypothesis: When structural observability is guaranteed via an unauthenticated /schema endpoint and drift patterns are chosen to preserve partial endpoint access (permission_boundary blocks write/admin only; session_invalidation clears sessions but tokens remain valid), behavioral signals (HTTP 403 rate, session invalidation) and structural signals (schema diff from /schema) measure genuinely independent dimensions. The Pearson correlation between paired per-sample behavioral composite and structural composite scores across co-occurring drift+noise conditions will be below 0.3, because: (a) both signals are non-trivially observable on every co-occurring condition (no zero-imputed structural values), (b) within-condition stochastic variation in permission subsets and noise magnitudes creates genuine paired variation, and (c) the drift and noise patterns operate on orthogonal server mechanisms (auth middleware vs response generation).
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if: (1) Pearson |r| >= 0.3 on paired per-sample scores from co-occurring conditions (primary criterion); OR (2) fewer than 80% of co-occurring conditions have both behavioral composite > 0 AND structural composite > 0 simultaneously (both signals independently observable); OR (3) the behavioral signal fails to detect drift on permission_boundary or session_invalidation patterns (TP < 0.85). A valid scientific negative (r >= 0.3 with proper measurement) would confirm that behavioral and structural signals are non-orthogonal and the domain pivots to composite multi-signal classifiers.

baselines.description: Parent EXP-GRAPH-35166507358 pooled Pearson r = 0.593 on co-occurring conditions with signing_key_rotation (zero-imputed structural values). The new design eliminates zero-imputation.
baselines.expected: New |r| should be substantially lower than 0.593 if the parent inflation was caused by zero-imputation

baselines.description: Parent behavioral means were constant within each co-occurring condition (deterministic drift). New design adds within-condition stochastic variation to enable proper paired correlation.
baselines.expected: Within-condition variance > 0 for both behavioral and structural scores

baselines.description: If behavioral and structural signals truly operate on orthogonal server mechanisms (auth middleware vs response generation), the correlation should approach 0 under independent stochastic variation.

positive_control.description: permission_boundary drift (set write=False, admin=False) should produce HTTP 403 on write/admin endpoints and HTTP 200 on read endpoint, yielding behavioral composite > 0 on all 30 samples. This is the same mechanism proven in the parent (TP=1.0 for permission_boundary).
positive_control.expected: TP >= 0.90 across all permission_boundary co-occurring conditions

null_control.description: When schema noise is applied WITHOUT any drift (no permission change, no session invalidation), behavioral signals should not fire (FP = 0). This is the same null proven in the parent (FP=0.0 for all noise patterns).

measurement_validity: All behavioral signals derived from real HTTP request/response cycles on Flask 3.x + PyJWT HS256 localhost (not analytical computation)

Structural signals computed from an unauthenticated /schema endpoint that returns the current schema regardless of auth state, ensuring non-zero structural observability on ALL co-occurring conditions
Drift patterns limited to permission_boundary (blocks write/admin only) and session_invalidation (clears session store) — both preserve at least one accessible endpoint for structural probing
signing_key_rotation is EXCLUDED from co-occurring conditions because it blocks ALL endpoints (parent confound)

Within-condition stochastic variation: random permission subset (2^{3}-1=7 non-empty proper subsets for permission_boundary), random noise field count (1-3 fields), random response time jitter (50-150ms)
30 independent request sequences per condition with per-seed RNG for reproducibility
Structural signal from /schema endpoint is independent of auth state — cannot be masked by drift
Pearson r computed on paired per-sample (behavioral_i, structural_i) scores, NOT on condition means
All 8 co-occurring conditions (2 drift x 4 noise) have non-trivial variation in both signals (verified in preprocessing)
decision_rule: PASS if ALL of: (1) C1_drift_tp: mean TP rate across permission_boundary and session_invalidation co-occurring conditions >= 0.85 AND all Wilson lower CI > 0.75; (2) C2_observability: >= 80% of co-occurring sample pairs have BOTH behavioral composite > 0 AND structural composite > 0; (3) C3_orthogonality: Pearson |r| < 0.3 on paired per-sample scores from ALL co-occurring conditions pooled, AND permutation p < 0.05; (4) C4_null_control: FP rate on noise-only conditions = 0.0. FAIL if any criterion fails. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if fewer than 6 of 8 co-occurring conditions have sufficient within-condition variance (std > 0 for both signals), or if fewer than 240 paired samples are available.
product_consequence_positive: If orthogonality survives (|r| < 0.3), C-FRESHNESS gains a validated second detection channel. The product pipeline can integrate behavioral signals alongside structural signals for composite freshness detection, with each channel providing independent information. This enables multi-signal freshness guards that are robust to single-channel failures.
product_consequence_negative: If orthogonality fails (|r| >= 0.3 with proper measurement), behavioral and structural signals are confirmed non-orthogonal. The product pipeline must use composite multi-signal classifiers rather than independent parallel channels, or rely on behavioral signals alone (since they already pass C1-C3). The freshness detection architecture pivots from parallel independent channels to fused classifiers.
estimated_cost: Low: Flask server reuse from parent with minor modifications (add /schema endpoint, exclude signing_key_rotation from co-occurring, add stochastic permission subsets). 8 co-occurring conditions x 30 samples = 240 paired measurements, plus 8 noise-only x 30 = 240 null control samples. Runtime ~10 minutes.
expected_information_gain: High: this is the minimum next step that can change a product decision. If |r| < 0.3, the product gains a validated second detection dimension for freshness. If |r| >= 0.3, the architecture pivots to fused classifiers. Either outcome is decision-relevant and was blocked by the parent's measurement confound.
